detail.longDescription: CVE-2026-129433 — Dokploy, CVSS 9.9. Authenticated RCE on the self-hosted Docker deployment platform. Any org member can reach root on the host. AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H — the S:C scope change crosses from the web app to the Docker daemon. Root on the host = every container, volume, env var, and secret the team deployed. The access control for this CVE is the member list. Audit it after the patch. https:// threataft.com/articles/cve-202 6-129433-dokploy-authenticated-rce-docker # CVE2026129433 # Docker # RCE
